about.description:
Ergonomic bindings for nanomsg next generation (nng), in Python. pynng
provides a nice interface on top of the full power of nng. nng, and
therefore pynng, make it easy to communicate between processes on a
single computer or computers across a network. This library is
compatible with Python ≥ 3.5. nng is the rewriting of Nanomsg, which
is the spiritual successor to ZeroMQ.
about.summary: Python bindings for Nanomsg Next Generation.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pynng
  version: "0.9.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/pynng-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fcd839abf82a2934fa8c27ff57b574b41810458e35895bac6288814defa8fb4e
  patches:
    - if: not win
      then: fix-osx-linux.patch

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cffi
    - cmake
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ninja
    - make
    - setuptools
  host:
    - cffi
    - pip
    - pytest-runner
    - python
    - if: not win
      then: 
        - mbedtls =3.6.3.1
        - nng =1.11
  run:
    - cffi
    - python
    - sniffio
    - if: not win
      then:
        - mbedtls =3.6.3.1
        - nng =1.11
tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pynng
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Python bindings for Nanomsg Next Generation.
  description: |
    Ergonomic bindings for nanomsg next generation (nng), in Python. pynng
    provides a nice interface on top of the full power of nng. nng, and
    therefore pynng, make it easy to communicate between processes on a
    single computer or computers across a network. This library is
    compatible with Python ≥ 3.5. nng is the rewriting of Nanomsg, which
    is the spiritual successor to ZeroMQ.
  homepage: https://github.com/codypiersall/pynng
  repository: https://github.com/codypiersall/pynng
  documentation: https://pynng.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
    - carlodri
    - thomasmarwitz
